text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown gives her all despite the 
short preparation time. She doesn't slack 
on research, even analyzing her rivals' 
thinking habits through games.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, no information on Duramente could 
be obtained. It seemed they were keeping 
everything confidential out of caution. 
And so, the day of the race arrived—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Brimming with fighting spirit, Duramente 
steps onto the grounds. Her undeniable 
aura, completely distinct from before, 
utterly overwhelms those around her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even so, Satono Crown had devised hundreds 
of possible race scenarios. She wouldn't 
surrender the Satsuki Sho victory to 
anyone—!
